text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black once bemoaned her lack of eye-catching qualities, but now, fans have voted her as the most popular Umamusume, and she's ready for the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her showdown with Brusquement is finally here. There's no need to imitate another's talent. All they must do is make the most of their unique skills.
